bluf: Posture Normal. No WashU Alert, no threat naming WashU, no outage on a WashU asset, no severe weather in 72 h. One life-safety signal: two shootings at short-term-rental parties in Ring 1 in four days (child critically hurt on 5500 Pershing Nov 4). First Freeze Warning of the season midnight to 8 AM Sat on a lightly staffed weekend. Fri-Sun stacked: Field House tournaments, Loop Dia de los Muertos Sat evening, St. Louis Half Marathon in Forest Park Sun morning. New federal cold-chain advisory puts Medical Campus freezers in scope.
